name: ContainerNursery
description: Puts Docker Containers to sleep and wakes them back up when they're needed. Written in Node.js, this application acts as a HTTP reverse proxy and stops Docker containers which haven't been accessed recently and starts them again when a new request comes in. ContainerNursery also makes sure there are no more active WebSocket connections before stopping the container. To improve the user experience a loading page is presented, which automatically reloads when the containers webserver is ready.

paths.name: Config directory
paths.description: Where the config.yml file should be stored.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Should point to /var/run/docker.sock to be able to control the docker instance.

variables.name: CN_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Sets the minimum log level. Log entries below this importance level won't be printed to the console. Defaults to info. Available values: debug / info / warn / error

variables.name: CN_LOG_JSON
variables.description: If set to true all logging is done in a machine readable format (JSON). Defaults to false. Available values: true / false
